title: The Pink Ghost Coffee Bar
intro: I wanted Halloween in the kitchen without anything that would scare the kids at breakfast. So: pink ghosts with a BOO sign, flameless candles printed with pumpkins and bats, pink and white jack-o-lanterns, a big messy drape of pink creepy gauze and a flock of paper bats up the wall. It went up in one evening, the box is still half unpacked, and I have zero regrets.

images.alt: A brown haired woman laughing as she sticks pink and black paper bats on her kitchen wall, with pink ghost figurines, pumpkin candles, jack-o-lanterns and pink creepy gauze on the counter.

A pink Halloween coffee bar on a chippy sideboard with ghost figurines, flameless pumpkin and bat candles, pink and white jack-o-lanterns, pink creepy gauze with fairy lights, mugs, candy corn and ghost cookies, and paper bats on the wall.

Pink Halloween decor finds on a wood sideboard: pink ghost figurines with a BOO sign, pink and black flameless candles, pink and white jack-o-lanterns, pink creepy gauze and paper bats on a plum wall.
